_readme: THE MERRIMACK (M12 step 5a; a place since 2026-10-21): the estuary in the one world frame, from the
north jetty tip -- what `gagame --sea` has always meant. It stands on scenes/world.json, the atlas,
and says only what is the place's: its anchor (the ACT0816 current station at the mouth), its views
(scenes/views/builtin.json and below), the solver's box, the wave field's window and the bar's
normal, the sea state's fallback box, the AIS lane the fleet rides, and its rails, portals and
entities. Its bed, tides, currents, river (the Merrimack's face, discharge and prism come from
data.river's reach), buildings and roads are the world's.
